visual_descriptors.downtown_la: tall glass-and-steel high-rises, dense building frontage, broad multilane streets, and sparse street trees
visual_descriptors.hollywood: low- and mid-rise commercial blocks, theater marquees and billboards, palm-lined boulevards, and dry hills behind the street grid
visual_descriptors.beverly_hills: polished low-rise retail facades, large detached homes, manicured lawns and tall palms, and clean wide streets
visual_descriptors.santa_monica: mid-rise coastal blocks, broad boulevards, palms and drought-tolerant landscaping, and bright open streets near the ocean
visual_descriptors.venice_beach: eclectic low-rise buildings, colorful murals, palms, narrow residential streets, and pedestrian-oriented coastal blocks
visual_descriptors.koreatown: dense mid-rise apartment and commercial blocks, closely spaced storefronts, limited tree canopy, and wide traffic-heavy streets
visual_descriptors.pasadena: historic brick and Spanish-revival low-rise buildings, mature tree canopy, broad residential streets, and landscaped setbacks
visual_descriptors.long_beach: mid-rise waterfront blocks, industrial port structures, palms, broad avenues, and mixed residential-commercial streets
